caption: Piazza Grande, Arezzo
composition: Sloping square with loggia and medieval façades · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks up the sloping brick piazza from its lower end, the long arcaded facade of the loggia running along the right with its repeated stone arches, and the medieval brick houses with their bell tower massed at the left. Soft 07:39 morning light warms the brickwork while the square itself lies empty, the steep pitch of the paving drawing the eye uphill. The row of arches is the dominant rhythm, unbroken from foreground to the square's far end.
